analysis_name: CheXpert Label Uncertainty Sensitivity Analysis (U-Ignore vs U-Ones vs U-Zeros)
clinical_guidance: For high-acuity acute triage (Emergency Department / Trauma), adopt U-Ones to maximize screening sensitivity.
For confirmatory diagnosis and epidemiological prevalence surveillance, adopt U-Zeros to prevent false positive overtreatment.
In retrospective validation benchmarking, report U-Ignore alongside U-Ones and U-Zeros to establish reproducible upper and lower operational bounds.

Cardiomegaly.radiological_rationale: Consolidation and Pneumonia have high uncertainty (17.4%) because radiologists regularly hedge between patchy atelectasis, aspiration, infectious consolidation, and pulmonary edema. Treating hedges as positive (U-Ones) inflates false positive penalty, shifting optimal operating cutoffs downwards.
